theorem Roth.sub_mem_RSet.{u_1} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {r : σ → ℕ} {B : ℕ} {W' W'' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ},
  W' ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B → W'' ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B → W' ≠ W'' → W' - W'' ∈ Roth.RSet (↑B) r :=
fun {σ} {r} {B} {W' W''} h' h'' hne ↦
  ⟨sub_ne_zero.mpr hne,
    ⟨fun j ↦ LE.le.trans (degreeOf_sub_le j W' W'') (max_le (h'.left j) (h''.left j)), fun d ↦
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ |↑_a| ≤ ↑B) (coeff_sub σ d W' W'')))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≤ ↑B) (Eq.symm Int.cast_abs)))
          (cast
            (Eq.symm
              (Eq.trans (congrArg (LE.le ↑|W'.coeff d - W''.coeff d|) (Eq.symm (Int.cast_natCast B)))
                Int.cast_le._simp_1))
            (abs_sub_le_of_nonneg_of_le (h'.right d).left (h'.right d).right (h''.right d).left (h''.right d).right)))⟩⟩

DIFF250_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {r : σ → ℕ} {B : ℕ} {W' W'' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ},
  W' ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B → W'' ∈ Roth.boxFamily r B → W' ≠ W'' → W' - W'' ∈ Roth.RSet (↑B) r
